11:23pm: An eliminated team has beat a qualified team three days in a row now to keep 
the top-two spots open. All of DC's top-four batters got off to starts, Rahul and du 
Plessis put on 55. They got out close to each other but Nair and Atal kept going. There 
were big overs in the middle. The 11th, 13th and 14th in particular. Harpreet kept PBKS 
in the game with Nair's wicket but Stubbs joined Rizvi to take DC through. Rizvi, by the 
way, is mostly the POTM. His power hits were fantastic, used the crease nicely and 
scored heavily behind the wickets. Brar was the pick of the bowlers. Jansen and 
Omarzai were taken down. Arshdeep bowled okay but went wicketless. PBKS, like DC, 
couldn't hold onto half-chances in the field. 
Vishnu : "If CSK beats GT tomorrow, we will have entertainment with suspense 
guaranteed till last league match."

Shreyas Iyer, PBKS captain: 207 was a fantastic score on this wicket. There was some 
variable bounce and it wasn't coming on at the same pace. We weren't disciplined 
enough with ball. We assessed the wicket and decided to bowl hard lengths at the 
stumps, but we went overboard with bouncers trying to take wickets. Every team is 
equally poised in this tournament, you gotta stay positive and calm. We'll come back 
with a strong set of plans. No issues with the body, just the finger, should be fine for the 
next game. 
Karun Nair: Feels amazing, we truly deserve this. Haven't been at our best. But tonight 
shows we're a good team that had bad games. I've been hitting the ball really well, came 
into the tournament with a lot of runs. Confidence was high. I was playing too many 
shots too early, coaches told me to take my time and then go big. (On Test selection) 
Grateful to get back, happy and proud and fortunate. Found out like all of you found out. 
Was eagerly awaiting the call, got a lot of messages from close ones. 
Gotten quite windy as the presentation starts. 
Faf du Plessis, DC captain: Finishing on a high is important. Fifth is a fair reflection of 
our season, need to be more consistent to be in the top-four. (How'd the season slip 
after four wins) One of the great mysteries. Combination of confidence, lack of form 
and basics. When you're playing well, small margins go with you. Every single time, 
there were five-six over windows in both batting and bowling where we let it slip. Vippy 
was amazing this season, he was a find for us with the ball, he was good with bat too 
making him a great asset. Two or three batters who are great as well. 
Sameer Rizvi, POTM: Feels good to get the POTM. Have been working hard for 2-3 
months about my game. I didn't have confidence before that I'd do well, but it has come 
after this innings. When I went in, we needed more than 120. I took 4-5 balls, knew that 
the wicket was good, and then played my shots.
